executive: Veldhara’s July to September engagement reviewed privacy and information security. This ISO 27001 view uses the approved control conclusions and their linked evidence at the 6 October cut-off. Physical safeguards are the strongest assessed area. Organizational controls are the weakest, with incomplete access reviews and untested incident response. The ISO score is 84%, but it should be read alongside those high-risk gaps. The separate DPDPA result is 44%; the two scores are not combined.
posture: 84.3% overall ISO score. Organizational controls are weakest at 69.4%; physical controls are strongest at 100.0%. Resolve the high-risk access, supplier and incident-response gaps before treating the overall score as assurance.
